The NIPA cell is the third US interest concept (§14): NIPA/IMA interest including imputed pension interest and TIPS accrual, which is wider than T12 D.41. source_label: BEA NIPA Table 3.16, total-government block: G16036 Retirement

CONCEPT: the NIPA sub-function is retirement — OASI including survivors' benefits — so it is WIDER than COFOG 10.2 by 10.3's survivors, and the remainder GF10_X is correspondingly narrower. Current expenditures only; NIPA Table 3.17 has no retirement investment cell and none is expected. Never a forecast source
consolidation_treatment: total government (NIPA Table 3.16 lines 1-41; federal from line 43)

source_label: BEA NIPA Table 3.16, total-government block: G16038 Unemployment
inclusion_note: APPLIED. D26 Level II proxy for COFOG 10.5 (unemployment): level2_proxy_actual, grade B, concept_flag level2_bea_function, restricted to 1970-2024. CONCEPT: benefits plus administration, current expenditures only — the closest available reading of 10.5 and slightly wider than benefits alone. The share is small and strongly cyclical (it peaks with recessions), so a stable share is not expected and none is assumed. Never a forecast source
consolidation_treatment: total government (NIPA Table 3.16 lines 1-41; federal from line 43)

source_label: BEA NIPA Table 3.16, total-government block: G16018 Transportation
inclusion_note: APPLIED, with a known under-coverage (OQ-15, RESOLVED on its default as D-S17-002). D26 asks for transportation current expenditure PLUS gross investment; NIPA Table 3.17 publishes gross investment by function for the nine Level I functions only (lines 105-133) and capital transfers by function at 134-145, so no transportation gross-investment cell exists in the flat files and the capital part of 04.5 is not separable cell-for-cell. The proxy is therefore the current-expenditure cell ALONE: level2_proxy_actual, grade B, concept_flag level2_bea_function, 1970-2024. Highways and transit investment stay inside Economic affairs gross investment (Table 3.17 line 109) and therefore inside the remainder GF04_X. No share is applied to split it: constructing the capital part would be a construction (D13). Never a forecast source
consolidation_treatment: total government (NIPA Table 3.16 lines 1-41; federal from line 43)
evidence: USA 1959-2024 (proxy rows 1970-2024); 2024 = USD 262,560 mn = 0.2685 of GF04 (2000: 0.2418; 1990: 0.2556; 1970: 0.2485) — a current-expenditure share of a parent that includes investment, so it is a floor on 04.5, not an estimate of it
